[Style] Authentic Cycling Vlog, mix of action cam + phone front cam + car tracking, 4K Photorealistic, overcast soft light, skin with sweat and real pores, no beauty filters, vertical 9:16

[Duration] 30 seconds

[Scene] Post-rain mountain road, wet surface with reflections, metal railings, distant mountains with moving clouds, water droplets on roadside greenery

[Character] Female cyclist (white helmet, blue mirror glasses, dark grey jersey with city print, red shorts with white side seams, pink sports watch, black carbon road bike)

[Glasses Rule] Glasses worn only during full-speed riding (Shots 2, 5, 6); parked or selfie shots (Shots 1, 3, 4, 7, 8) have glasses on the helmet forehead, fully exposing face and eyes

[Global Constraints] Same outfit throughout; sweat increases over time; hands only on handlebars/phone; no third hands or other cyclists

[00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Ground-level Low Angle
Extremely low机位. Wet asphalt bottom. She stops, one foot down, glasses on helmet. She looks at the camera and smiles. Actions: Puts on glasses, clips into pedals, starts riding through a puddle. SFX: Pedal click, chain movement, tire water splash.

[00:04-00:08] Shot 2: Car-to-car Side Tracking
Parallel tracking shot. Full body in view. Leaning low, pedaling hard, glasses on. Speed lines from passing railings and clouds. Detail: First sweat appearing, small sweat patch on jersey back.

[00:08-00:12] Shot 3: Front Camera Selfie POV
Handheld phone view. Stopped at roadside, foot down, glasses pushed to helmet. Action: Grins and breathes heavily, says something to camera, then turns camera to show the scenery before turning back. Detail: Shiny sweat on forehead, visible wind blowing hair, realistic handheld shake and wind noise.

[00:12-00:16] Shot 4: 360 Action Cam / Invisible Selfie Stick
Fish-eye distortion, invisible stick. She's parked, glasses on forehead. Camera circles her once. Action: Looks up at camera, makes a "let's go" gesture. Detail: Fine sweat on arms, sweat ring under watch strap.

[00:16-00:20] Shot 5: Handheld Close-up / Uphill
Side close-up of face and shoulders. Steep climb, glasses on, pedaling slow and heavy. Action: Gritted teeth, rocking the bike, heavy breathing, neck veins visible. Sweat drop slides down temple. Detail: Jersey soaked through, helmet strap sweat marks, glasses slightly fogged.

[00:20-00:23] Shot 6: Handlebar POV / First-person
Fixed handlebar view showing bike, cycling computer, and hands. Action: Speeding down curves, leaning into turns, splashing through puddles. Finger presses brake. Heavy wind noise and motion blur.

[00:23-00:27] Shot 7: Static Medium Shot
Bike leaning on railing. She gets off, removes helmet, glasses hanging from fingers, wipes sweaty hair back. Action: Drinks water, water spills down neck, wipes chin, long sigh. Detail: Helmet hair, red flushed face, goggle marks around eyes, sweat lines on collarbone.

[00:27-00:30] Shot 8: Low Angle Pull-back
Low angle looking up. Re-wears helmet, glasses on forehead. Stands by bike, giving a peace sign, smiling while breathing. Mountains and clouds behind. Camera pulls back slowly. SFX: Chain sound, shifting, heavy breathing, wind noise only at the end.

prompt:
[Generation Goal]
@img1 Generate a 30-second one-shot adventure action film. The central subject is a male explorer, and the core event is a continuous breakthrough of trap zones in an underground temple, eventually reaching the treasure. No audience, no studio; a real ancient ruin.

[Global Settings]
1. Environment/Texture: Interior of an underground ancient temple. Giant stone walls covered in moss, cracked slate floors, narrow beams of light leaking from ceiling cracks, orange torchlight on the walls. Dust floating in the air. Extremely realistic physical textures—worn stone, leather scratches, sweat and dust.
2. Visual Style: Adventure movie live-action feel, cinematic, shallow depth of field, mixed lighting of warm torch tones and cool light beams, film grain.
3. Shot Language: Unedited one-shot, Steadicam follow shot. Never place the character in the center—always an eccentric composition at the left or right one-third, leaving guiding space in front of the movement direction, alternating between side profile and 3/4 rear angles by section.
4. Character: An East Asian male explorer in his thirties. Black short hair, tanned skin, old brown leather jacket, khaki shirt, wide-brimmed brown fedora hat, crossbody leather messenger bag, leather gloves, holding a torch in one hand. Same person and same clothing throughout.
5. Performance Core: Instant reflective actions at the moment a trap is triggered, rapid breathing, a brief glance back after landing, a suppressed smile in front of the treasure.
6. Prohibitions: No subtitles or screen text, no BGM, no random scene cuts, no audience/host/studio lighting/neon/game show elements, no gore, no character fixed in the screen center.

[Timestamp Storyboard]
Stage 1: 0-5s [Entrance and First Trap]
The man is passing through a narrow stone door with a torch—the camera follows him from a 3/4 rear angle, placing him at the right one-third. On the second step, a stone slab clicks and sinks; darts shoot continuously from wall holes. The man dives and rolls forward, darts hitting the wall behind him.
End State: Man on one knee, darts in the wall behind him. Torch still in hand.

Stage 2: 5-12s [Waterway Stepping Stones]
Continued from previous stage: same clothing, torch maintained. The floor breaks into a black underground waterway—six square stepping stones arranged in a zigzag. The man jumps continuously across. As he steps, each stone sinks slowly with bubbles rising; he jumps to the next before it sinks. Camera parallel at water level—man at left one-third, guiding space ahead.
Emotion: This jump is not acrobatics but calculated progress—eyes always looking at the next stone.
End State: Man lands on the opposite stone platform, the last stone completely submerged.

Stage 3: 12-18s [Pendulum Blade Corridor]
Three giant half-moon stone pendulums hang from the ceiling, swinging alternately. The man observes the rhythm, then passes through in a stop-dash-stop manner. For the last one, he leans back to let it pass his chest. Camera side-on along the corridor wall; pendulums cross the foreground periodically.
End State: Man at the end of the corridor, pendulums still swinging.

Stage 4: 18-24s [Collapsing Bridge Sprint]
Beyond the corridor arch, an old stone bridge spans a chasm. The moment the man steps out, the bridge slabs collapse into the darkness one by one. Man sprints at full speed—the collapse chasing his heels. He leaps at the bridge end and rolls onto the opposite floor. Camera chases from a 3/4 low rear angle, man at right one-third, collapsing bridge filling the left.
End State: Man down after landing, bridge completely collapsed, only darkness in the chasm.

Stage 5: 24-30s [Treasure Chamber]

Dialogue: "Kuyashii!" (How frustrating!)

SFX: Huge cheers and applause peaking.

prompt: High-quality anime footage. Movie-theater-class high-density 2D hand-drawn action anime. High-speed melee combat. Set in a dark near-future giant corridor, the protagonist continuously breaks through multiple enemies without stopping. Most important are the overwhelming speed, grounding, chain of reaction forces, clear contact, extremely changing camera distances, short 'face rewards' (clear face shots), and instantaneous graphic impacts in red, black, and white in the latter half. Do not create segments of standing still to re-pose. Use the reaction of each attack as the start of the next movement or attack. [Protagonist Fixed] Maintain the protagonist from the source reference image as the same person in all cuts. Do not change face shape, age feel, eye size and spacing, iris color, jaw, bangs, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, body type, or unique color scheme. Even during high-speed movement, distant views, or backlit explosions, do not allow the character to become a different person, look older, or become simplified. The moment the shot returns to a close-up, accurately revert to the same face, eyes, and hair as the source reference image. The protagonist's weapon is only one slender single-edged sword. Maintain the blade, guard, and hilt as a single continuous structure. Do not multiply, branch, or exchange weapons. Hands always grip only the hilt, and do not overlap the blade and hands in front of the face. [Enemies Fixed] Four humanoid enemy soldiers wearing black near-future armor. All four maintain a similar armor design and do not mix faces, hair, outfits, or weapons with the protagonist. Enemies maintain humanoid bodies, black armor, and limbs even during combat. After being hit, they do not transform into crystals, abstract objects, or clumps of light. [Art Style Fixed] Entirely 2D hand-drawn anime. Thin, delicate line art, dark but not overly black outlines, two-to-three-tier anime shading, transparent mid-shades, multilayered highlights on hair and eyes, high-density background art, and exaggerated key animation for theater-quality action. Use short smear frames with boldly stretched shapes during high-speed action as needed, but return the face to clarity during face reward frames. Do not use thick black outlines, simplified TV-style animation, low-density backgrounds, flat single-layer cel shading, smooth 3DCG, live-action style, semi-realism, dull colors, or mixed art styles. [Setting/Color/Light] The setting is a dark, massive near-future corridor. Maintain the same location throughout. Use black, dark navy, and dark blue-green as basic background colors, with thin red linear lighting on walls, floors, and ceilings. Red light lines point toward the vanishing point at the end of the corridor, emphasizing speed direction and depth. Fix color roles: Cyan-Blue = Protagonist's acceleration and electrical afterglow; Lime-Yellow Green = Sword attack trails; Orange-Yellow = Sparks and explosions after contact; Red-Black-White = Graphic impact used only for the final shock in the latter half. Do not exchange color roles between cuts. Keep skin tones and protagonist-specific colors stable, avoiding random white balance changes. [Common Movement Rules] Do not process running as a parallel slide of the body. Sequence: Grounding foot fixed to floor -> Pelvis passes over supporting leg -> Opposite knee moves forward -> Toes of supporting leg kick the floor -> Short aerial phase -> Opposite foot grounds forward -> Knee compresses -> Next kick. The pelvis and ribcage themselves must advance across floor joints. Even if the camera follows, do not eliminate the protagonist's movement amount in world coordinates. Landing must always pass briefly through: Foot grounding -> Knee compression -> Hips sinking -> Upper body following. Sword contact reaction force should not be absorbed only by the wrist; flow it through: Sword -> Wrist -> Elbow -> Shoulder -> Ribcage -> Hips -> Supporting leg, passing that reaction and hip rotation into the next movement without stopping. Hair, clothing hems, and decorations follow the body with a slight delay. [Contact Rules] All important attacks follow this order: Clear gap between sword and enemy before contact -> Sword contacts specified position -> Very short hit-stop only at the moment of contact -> Sparks, armor displacement, enemy center-of-gravity change, and explosion only after contact. Do not blow enemies away before contact. Do not generate explosions before contact. Do not create static screens showing only effects; continue character movement while sparks or explosions are visible. [Full 10 Cuts Breakdown] [Cut 1 | Floor Ignition] Starts with an ultra-low-angle extreme close-up of the protagonist's feet. The front foot grounds strongly. The sole catches the floor, and the knee compresses for a split second. The moment the toes kick off, thin lime-green friction sparks fly backward. Cyan electrical afterglow runs briefly from ankle to leg. Camera runs parallel to the floor with the protagonist, showing grounding, kicking, and the pelvis advancing. The protagonist doesn't stop, converting the kick into high-speed acceleration. Ends with upper body leaning forward entering the next stride. [Cut 2 | Corridor Acceleration] Inherits the forward lean and speed. Protagonist advances into the corridor using alternating high-speed strides. Floor joints and red wall lights blur backward. Camera follows from a low front position, retreating at the same speed. Strong wide-angle perspective shows face, chest, knees, legs, and the corridor vanishing point. Orange explosion occurs far behind, but protagonist doesn't look back. Explosion pressure pushes hair and hems forward momentarily. Just before the next enemy appears, protagonist grounds the right foot and drops hips low for a slash. [Cut 3 | Face Reward to First Slash] Inherits right-foot support and forward speed. Camera catches up at high speed, zooming in momentarily from chest to face. Face and eyes are clear, but movement doesn't stop. Protagonist glares at the enemy, smirking slightly and exhaling a short breath. Rotates hips and swings the sword in a single path from bottom-diagonal to top-diagonal. Clear gap before contact. Short hit-stop when blade hits enemy torso armor. Thick lime slash trail and orange sparks cross the screen diagonally after contact. Enemy's upper body buckles; protagonist converts reaction into leftward movement. Lime blade light crosses the lens, providing a transition to the next camera axis. changes: 仅做提取与空白/Markdown 代码块格式规范化，提示词文字未做任何改动（含错别字）；未收录任何图片/视频。

prompt:
High-quality anime footage. High-density 3D toon/cel-look. Cinematic high-fantasy action set in a rainy magic city. A pink-haired girl mage intercepts a giant black dragon's fire breath with a magic shield, teleports to the side using the counterforce, and fires a high-output beam from a convergence gate on her right palm, causing the dragon to crumble into black ash and magic particles.
[Character Identity and Role of Reference Images]
image1 is the top priority reference for the protagonist's face and identity. Maintain a soft oval young face, small chin, large blue-violet to purple-pink eyes, multi-layered iris with white highlights, delicate eye area, long coral pink twin-tails, light bangs, lavender flowers on both sides, and black-purple ribbons with gold decorations throughout.
image2 is the reference for the protagonist's outfit, decorations, full-body design, and equipment. Maintain a slender and small build, navy-to-purple gold-trimmed cape, white frill blouse, black-purple corset, purple multi-layered pleated skirt, white knee-highs, dark purple boots with metal fittings, waist belt, amethyst crystals, magic potions, and a magic book with gold decorations.
If references conflict, prioritize image1 for the face, eyes, and hair ornaments, and image2 for the outfit, build, and equipment. The two images are only for appearance; do not bring background, composition, poses, white background, or layout lines into the video.
Only allowed changes are focused expressions, eye direction, breathing, combat stance, and natural movement of hair/cape/skirt. Do not allow face averaging, feature mixing, outfit changes, equipment multiplication, or additional characters.
[Art Style: High-Density 3D Toon/Cel-Look]
This style does not override character identity. Fine, delicate colored outlines. Clear two-to-three-stage cel shading and transparent intermediate shadows on the face, hair, and outfit. Multi-layered highlights on eyes and hair. Use pink, lavender, navy, purple, and gold as the main color axis for the protagonist. Distinctly depict cloth, frills, leather, metal, amethyst, wet stone, and glass with different reflections. Theatrical-grade key animation, high-quality compositing, and dense background art. For magic, use high-brightness graphic VFX, volumetric light, additive emission, and directional motion blur. Avoid thick black outlines, flat single-layer shadows, or low-density plastic CG looks.
[Equipment and State Transitions]
Only one magic book. Maintain the same binding and thickness throughout. Open it with the left hand only in Cut 1, close it and return it to the waist holder in Cut 2. Keep amethyst crystals and potions attached to the belt. All attacks come from the right palm, not the book. Do not introduce new items not in image2.
[Black Dragon Fixing]
Only one giant black four-legged winged dragon, about four times the protagonist's height. One head, two horns, two glowing blue-white eyes, a continuous neck and torso, four legs with three claws each. One pair of wings continuous from the back bones. One tail branching from the lower back to the tip. The impact point is a single point on the chest scales. No extra heads, legs, or wings.
[Setting]
A massive magic city after the rain. Grand avenues of wet obsidian and blue-gray stone, shallow puddles, ancient cracks, and crumbling arch bridges. Surrounded by soaring magic towers, spires, floating turrets, and giant crystal pillars. City lighting is cyan, royal blue, violet, and purple. Keep background light one step darker than the protagonist to highlight her pink, lavender, and gold colors. No readable text; only abstract geometric patterns glowing faintly on stone and crystal surfaces.
[Space and Continuity]
Cuts 1-2: Protagonist in the left foreground, dragon in the right middle ground. Attack axis is a diagonal from back-right to front-left.
Cut 2: Teleportation through a magic gate momentarily swaps left-right positioning once.
Cuts 3-6: Protagonist in the right foreground, dragon in the left background. Align the right palm, gate center, beam, and dragon's chest in a straight line. Do not swap left-right positions after this.
In adjacent cuts, change at least two of the following: camera height, distance to protagonist, character size, or vanishing axis. Use camera movement to show contact, force, or space, not as a substitute for character movement. Maintain natural acceleration and parallax.
Cut 1: Fire Breath and Shield
Black dragon is in the right background. Steps into the stone floor, pulls neck back, chest swells, and throat glows orange-purple.

prompt:
Ultra-High Mobility/Non-Aerodynamic Autonomous Attack Aircraft vs. Humanoid High-Speed Combat Robot

[Video Concept] A giant high-speed combat robot commands approximately 10 fist-sized autonomous attack aircraft, evading machine gun fire from a giant humanoid combat robot through abnormal three-dimensional maneuvers that completely ignore the common sense of aircraft. The small attack aircraft do not turn; they move linearly at high speeds, stop suddenly, and instantaneously bend the movement vector itself at acute angles of 90, 120, or 150+ degrees to accelerate instantly in a different direction. They change positions to stereoscopically 'erode' the space around the enemy robot, deploying in multiple directions before the enemy can react. Finally, signaled by a large downward swing from the command robot, the 10 units synchronize perfectly for a simultaneous all-out attack from all directions. The enemy robot is engulfed in a massive explosion.

Overall Video Theme: "A swarm of autonomous attack aircraft that leap through space itself at high speed, rather than flying."

[World Setting] Far future. An era where three-dimensional maneuverable weapons, inexplicable by conventional aerodynamics, have been realized through advanced propulsion technology, omnidirectional attitude control, and artificial gravity control. The setting is over a massive futuristic city. A sea of clouds and giant cumulonimbus cover the spaces between massive skyscrapers, with explosions, smoke, and debris from combat in the distance. Daytime. Strong winds. High-altitude giant clouds. Aerial combat between giant humanoid high-speed robots. Next-generation aerial combat between a manned high-speed combat robot and a swarm of autonomous small attack aircraft. The small aircraft are not conventional aircraft; they do not rely on lift or turn radius but change movement vectors instantly via omnidirectional thrust. Their inertia appears extremely low. They stop instantly during high-speed movement and move in a different direction without deceleration. The movement looks like high-speed switching of spatial coordinates rather than "flight."

[Visual Style] Theatrical Japanese animation quality. Ultra-high-quality cel animation. Precise mecha animation. High-end sci-fi action. High-density drawing. High-definition cel shading. Realistic physics-based lighting. Sharp, precise line art. Complex mechanical details. Movie-quality compositing. Bold perspective. Great depth. High spatial density.

[Animation Direction] Most Important Motion Principles: Explosive animation, snappy timing, strong anticipation, powerful acceleration, large body mechanics, sharp ease-out, heavy follow-through, pronounced inertia, dynamic camera choreography, fast action arcs, high kinetic energy. Every movement begins decisively and ends with visible momentum. No sluggish movement. The movement of the large robot conveys massive mass. Clear anticipation before starting. The shoulders, waist, and legs move in coordination. Clear follow-through from weight during sudden stops. Shoulders, elbows, and wrists follow with a slight delay after arm swings. The entire frame drifts slightly due to inertia after high-speed movement. Conversely, small attack aircraft are the opposite of the large robot—extremely agile, small, fast, and precise. They start and stop in an instant. The time from start to maximum speed is extremely short. Eliminate wasteful preparatory movements. Agility, efficiency, and mechanically precise movement are prioritized. "Snappy movement," "instant change of position," and "movement the moment a decision is made" are the top priorities.

[Colors and Lighting] Command Robot: White, gunmetal, navy base with small red markings. Drones: Dark metallic, pale blue luminescent parts, pale blue propulsion light. Enemy Robot: Dark gray, black, navy heavy armor with red sensors. Sunlight is strong and harsh. Intense volumetric light from between clouds. Sharp highlights on armor. Explosions emphasize white, orange, and red.

[Large Command Robot] Height approx 8m. Slender, athlete-like humanoid silhouette. Long limbs, narrow waist, angular armor. Streamlined, aggressive head. Narrow luminescent sensors. White, gunmetal, navy armor. Small red markings. A launch unit on the back stores 10 drones. No large handheld weapons; hands are free, controlling drones via conductor-like gestures.

[Enemy High-Speed Combat Robot] Height approx 9m. Massive presence. Equipped with large propulsion units for high-speed flight. Maintains humanoid silhouette. Heavy armor. Built-in machine guns in arms. Fires massive rounds while flying. High firepower but cannot change direction instantly like drones; has clear inertia and needs to tilt for turns. Sudden stops cause the body to drift forward.

[Small Autonomous Attack Aircraft] Approx 10 units. Fist-sized. Angular mechanical structure. No wings or tail fins. Omnidirectional thrust units. Not small fighters, but autonomous spatial weapons. [Movement Principles] Do not turn like aircraft. No banking, no large arcs, no turn radius. Basic movement: Linear move -> Instant stop -> Acute angle turn -> Instant acceleration. Locus is straight lines and sharp angles. Instant vector changes (90/120/150 deg). Movements like spatial jumping.

[Camera Direction] Avoid fixed heights. Use low/high angles, bird's-eye, worm's-eye, horizontal, diagonal, close-ups, and telephoto compression. The camera moves heavily with the robot's weight but uses sharp, short movements for drones. High-speed pans, instant stops, and quick reframing. Use 'disappearing/reappearing' shots. Show the abnormal trajectory through fixed-camera shots during key actions.

[00:00-00:05 Launch] Futuristic city. Command robot static in air. Low angle looking up. Launch unit opens, 10 drones fire out. They stop, then accelerate in different directions (up, side, diagonal) on robot's command, then return to formation. Camera tilts to show the 3D loci.

[00:05-00:10 Evasion] Enemy enters city. High-speed fire. Drones stop and accelerate in 10 different directions to vanish from the line of fire. Strong motion blur and high-speed pans. The drones seem to vanish from the line of fire rather than 'dodge.'

[00:10-00:15 Abnormal Maneuvers] Enemy fires continuously. One drone flies towards the muzzle, stops, then instantly shifts 90 degrees as the bullets pass. Drones shift vertically and horizontally with mechanical precision. No sluggishness.

[00:15-00:20 3D Siege] Drones gather around enemy. Camera uses layers (foreground/midground/background) rather than rotating. Drones block the view, then appear on the other side. Siege is dynamic, with drones entering and exiting the frame from all heights and distances.

[00:20-00:25 Silence and Command] Time slows. Command robot moves to the front with heavy weight. Conducts drones into a 3D formation (front, back, left, right, up, down). Large, slow wind-up for the final signal.

[00:25-00:30 All-Out Attack] Command robot swings arm down powerfully. 10 drones accelerate simultaneously from all directions. Enemy robot is surrounded by light and explodes in a massive, theatrical fireball. Final shot is a grand cinematic poster composition.

[Drone Motion Rules] Always high speed, no delay, minimal anticipation. Linear moves only. No banking, no turns, no curves. Sharp angle vector changes. Mechanically precise and explosive speed.

[Robot Motion Rules] Convey massive mass. Strong anticipation and follow-through. Contrast with drones' light speed. Weighty, powerful movements.

[Camera Motion Rules] Avoid single altitude. Use high-speed pans for drones. Use cuts and perspective to show 3D space rather than continuous rotation. The focus is the aircraft's movement performance.

[Speed Expression] Strong motion blur vs sharp stops. Extreme contrast between stillness and acceleration. Sudden shifts in speed.

[Physics] Robot: Gravity and inertia. Drones: Omnidirectional thrust, ignoring aerodynamics, coordinate-switching behavior.

[Environment] Drones slice clouds/smoke at sharp angles. Blue propulsion glows. Massive shockwaves from explosion. Particles are pushed aside at high speeds.

[Important Prohibitions] Do not depict small attack aircraft as normal fighters...

[Speed Expression] Strong motion blur vs sharp stops. Extreme contrast between stillness and acceleration. Sudden shifts in speed.

[Physics] Robot: Gravity and inertia. Drones: Omnidirectional thrust, ignoring aerodynamics, coordinate-switching behavior.

[Environment] Drones slice clouds/smoke at sharp angles. Blue propulsion glows. Massive shockwaves from explosion. Particles are pushed aside at high speeds.

[Important Prohibitions] Do not depict small attack aircraft as normal fighters...

path: prompts/漫剧/现实向/剧情短片/youmind-8918--Teacher-Japanese-Chalkboard-Writing-Anim.md
prompt: [Speech rule — read first] The woman speaks JAPANESE ONLY. She never speaks Chinese, English, or any other language. She speaks almost continuously for the whole clip. She says exactly this one sentence, broken into four phrases, in this order and nothing else: 「Seedance 2.5なら」 「黒板に日本語の文字を」 「書くことができます。」 「とても便利ですね」 She delivers it at the unhurried pace of a teacher writing on a board: her voice slows to the speed of her own chalk, so each phrase is spoken while her hand is forming that same phrase. Voice and chalk advance together. Only a short natural breath separates one phrase from the next — no long pause anywhere. Total speech fills roughly 13 of the 15 seconds. The only silence is the final 0.8 seconds, where she has finished writing and simply smiles and nods. Forbidden at all times: ad-libbed dialogue, filler words, repeating a phrase, reading the sentence twice, humming, laughing, sighing, and every wordless vocalisation such as "んっ" "うん" "ふふ" "ah" "mm" "hm". She says the four phrases once each and nothing more. Pronounce "Seedance 2.5" as English "seedance two point five". [Reference] @Image1 = the keyframe: a woman in a white coat standing beside a completely empty green chalkboard, holding a slim wooden pointer at her side. Strictly preserve @Image1's face, hair, glasses, white coat, the chalkboard's position and size, the easel, the background shelves, and the framing. Nothing moves in the frame except her arm, her upper body, her face, and the chalk marks she draws. [One-line summary] 15 seconds. A cheerful presenter gives a short lecture, writing four lines of Japanese on a green chalkboard with the tip of a wooden pointer while speaking the same words aloud. Pixar-style 3D animation. Locked-off static camera. [Global setup] Environment: warm indoor study room, soft warm ceiling light, shallow depth of field, background shelves stay blurred. Highly realistic physical texture on the chalk dust and the wood of the easel. Visual style: Pixar-style 3D animation, warm color grade, soft shadows. Camera language: medium shot, eye level, straight-on. The camera is completely locked off — no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no push-in, no handheld shake. One camera behavior only: none. Character: as in @Image1. Keep the glasses, the hair silhouette, and the coat identical. Keep believable skin shading and fine surface detail — do not make her look plastic. Acting core: a warm, confident teacher who enjoys showing something off. *** WRITING RULE — SHE IS THE ONE WRITING, AND SHE WRITES AS SHE SPEAKS. *** Every chalk mark is produced by her own hand movement, in time with her voice. For each phrase: 1. Her shoulder and elbow carry the pointer tip to the start of the line. Her torso turns slightly toward the board and her eyes go to that point first. 2. The tip presses lightly to the board and travels along the path of each stroke. The chalk line appears directly behind the moving tip, following it exactly, never running ahead of it, never appearing anywhere the tip has not touched. 3. Characters are formed one stroke at a time, in correct Japanese stroke order, left to right. Faint chalk dust puffs at the tip and a soft scraping sound follows it. 4. Between strokes the tip lifts a few centimetres, then sets down at the start of the next. 5. The syllables she speaks land together with the characters she is forming — when her voice reaches a word, her hand is writing that word. Voice and chalk stay in step. 6. At the end of each line she lowers the pointer slightly, takes one small breath, glances at the camera, then moves to the line below. Her arm leads and the mark follows — the timing of the arm and the timing of the mark must match frame for frame. Marks NEVER fade in as a whole word. Marks NEVER appear while her arm is at rest or while the tip is away from the board. No invisible hand. No magic writing. The arm motion is fluid and human: the wrist flexes, the elbow opens and closes, the shoulder carries the reach across the board, her body weight shifts slightly as she reaches. Once a line is finished it stays on the board unchanged for the rest of the shot. Japanese script rule (important): Render every kanji with its correct stroke structure and correct number of strokes — 黒 板 日 本 語 文 字 書 便 利. They must be legible as real Japanese characters, not invented or Chinese-simplified lookalikes. Write them at a generous size so the strokes stay separated. "Seedance 2.5" is written in Latin letters and digits exactly as spelled: S-e-e-d-a-n-c-e, space, 2, period, 5. Chalk colors — only two, never any other: YELLOW chalk for "Seedance 2.5" only. WHITE chalk for everything else. Layout rule (important): Four lines, left-aligned to a common left margin, stacked evenly down the board from top to bottom, filling the board by the end. Large, cheerful hand-lettered chalk style with slightly uneven strokes. Exact content, top to bottom: Seedance 2.5なら 黒板に日本語の文字を 書くことができます。 とても便利ですね Never centre a line. Never write small. Each line is written as large as it can be while still fitting: a completed line spans almost the full writable width of the board, from the left margin nearly to the right edge of the board, and the four lines together fill the board from top to bottom. Characters are wide and generously spaced so that dense kanji such as 黒 板 語 書 便 利 keep their strokes separated and legible. If a line would not fit, make the characters narrower rather than shorter in height — never shrink a line so that it occupies only part of the board's width. Do not add any other word, symbol, arrow, underline or drawing. Forbidden: no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen UI, no watermark, no background music, no camera movement, no cutting to another shot, no extra people, no second hand entering the frame, no stick of chalk held in her free hand, no distortion of lines already written. [Timestamp storyboard] 0.0-3.6s LINE 1 Action: she raises the pointer to the upper-left of the empty board and writes "Seedance 2.5なら" in YELLOW chalk — first the Latin letters and digits, then the kana なら — the marks trailing the moving tip. Speech (in step with the writing): 「Seedance 2.5なら」 Intent: a small proud lift in her eyebrows on the brand name. This is the thing she is showing off. Camera: locked. No subtitles. No BGM. Japanese only. 3.6-7.2s LINE 2 Action: she drops to the next line and writes "黒板に日本語の文字を" in WHITE chalk, stroke by stroke. Her eyes follow her own tip. Speech (in step with the writing): 「黒板に日本語の文字を」 Intent: matter-of-fact, the setup half of the sentence. Keep the arm steady and even. Camera: locked. No subtitles. No BGM. Japanese only. 7.2-11.0s LINE 3 Action: she drops to the third line and writes "書くことができます。" in WHITE chalk, stroke by stroke, ending with a firm dot for the 。 Speech (in step with the writing): 「書くことができます。」 Intent: this is the payoff of the sentence — her voice firms up slightly on ます, and the final dot is pressed with a small decisive tap. Camera: locked. No subtitles. No BGM. Japanese only. 11.0-15.0s LINE 4 — the close Action: she writes "とても便利ですね" in WHITE chalk on the bottom line, then lowers the pointer to her side, turns her face fully to the camera, breaks into an open warm smile and gives one clear nod. She holds that pose for the final 0.8 seconds in silence. Speech (in step with the writing, finishing by 14.2s): 「とても便利ですね」 Intent: the nod is the close. Warm, a little playful, as if sharing a good discovery. Camera: locked. No subtitles. No BGM. Japanese only. [Closing constraints — restated for the whole clip]

title: Seedance 2.0 的详细电影化提示
changes: 仅做提取与空白/Markdown 代码块格式规范化，提示词文字未做任何改动（含错别字）；未收录任何图片/视频。

prompt: [00:00–00:02] Wide establishing shot of the bizarre fantasy forest @image3 . Towering flesh-like tree trunks packed with blinking embedded eyes rise on both sides, glowing blue liquid runs down roots into occult circular markings on the ground, red storm sky beyond. The corridor feels alive and watching. CAM: slow low push forward, ominous and quiet. [00:02–00:04] The girl @image1 runs into frame through the center path, sprinting hard toward camera, red coat flaring, glowing eyes wide with fear and focus. Her shoes splash through glowing blue runoff, hair bouncing violently. CAM: handheld-style backward chase shot, low and fast. [00:04–00:06] Whip-pan reveal behind her: multiple grotesque monsters @image2 skitter and bound into the corridor, drooling blue slime, eyes rolling wildly, teeth bared. They move with jerky inhuman speed, legs scraping over the slick ground. CAM: snap whip-pan, then brief forward rush with the pack. [00:06–00:08] Sakuga cut barrage: close-up of her @image1 pounding feet through glowing symbols; coat sleeve whipping past lens; monster claws stabbing into the wet soil; embedded eyes in the trees blinking open; blue fluid splashing; one monster lunges just short of her back. Fast, sharp, chaotic cuts. [00:08–00:10] @image1 cuts hard left around a root mass, nearly slipping, catches herself, then vaults over a stream of glowing liquid. One monster @image2 crashes into the roots and another leaps across the frame with jaws wide. CAM: side tracking shot matching her sprint, aggressive parallax through the living trunks. [00:10–00:12] @image1 reaches a circular sigil clearing and skids to a stop at center. The monsters @image2 spread out around her at the edge of the frame, surrounding but not yet striking. The forest eyes all seem to stare inward. CAM: overhead-descending angle into a dramatic low angle on her bracing herself. [00:12–00:14] Horror standoff beat. @image1 slowly raises her head, glowing eyes intensifying, red coat settling in the blue-lit air. The nearest monster @image2 creeps forward, drool stretching, others twitching in anticipation. Blue runoff pulses brighter through the ground symbols. CAM: slow push-in, trembling atmosphere. [00:14–00:15] Final impact image: one monster @image2 explodes forward into frame as @image1 snaps into motion to counter, freezing on the instant before collision—glowing eyes, claws, teeth, flaring coat, occult light reflecting across the flesh-trees. Hard cut ending.

variants.text:
[00:00–00:02] 广角全景镜头，展现奇异的奇幻森林 @image3 。高耸的肉质树干上镶嵌着眨动的眼睛，树根处流淌着发光的蓝色液体，汇入地面上的神秘圆形符文，远处是红色的风暴天空。走廊仿佛活了一般，正在窥视着一切。镜头：缓慢、低角度向前推进，气氛不祥而寂静。

[00:02–00:04] 女孩 @image1 从画面中央的小径跑入，奋力冲向镜头，红色外套飞扬，发光的眼睛因恐惧和专注而睁大。她的鞋子溅起发光的蓝色水花，头发剧烈地晃动。镜头：手持式后退追逐镜头，低角度且快速。

path: prompts/真人/现实向/生活与vlog/youmind-893--手持摄像机美学下的深夜披萨坦诚时刻.md
prompt:
A dim bedroom lit by a harsh on-camera flash. White bedsheets fill most of the frame, slightly wrinkled and textured. An open pizza box sits nearby on the bed, its lid tilted back, revealing a partially eaten pizza.

A young woman lies on her back across the bed, head tilted slightly toward the camera. She wears a playful shirt patterned with cartoon pizza slices. Her hair spreads across the pillow.

The camera is held very close above her with a wide consumer lens, creating slight perspective distortion. The flash flattens shadows and creates glossy highlights on her eyes and the pizza grease.

She lifts a slice of pepperoni pizza above her face.

Slowly, she lowers it toward her mouth.

The cheese stretches slightly from the slice as it moves. Oil glistens on the pepperoni under the flash. The slice bends naturally as gravity pulls the tip downward.

She takes a bite.

The crust compresses between her fingers. The cheese pulls and separates unevenly as she bites through it. A small strand of melted cheese briefly stretches before snapping.

Her eyes remain fixed toward the camera as she chews.

The camera remains very close and handheld, shifting slightly as if the person filming adjusts their grip. The flash creates harsh reflections across the pizza box and glossy toppings.

Image quality shows consumer analog artifacts: visible grain, slight color noise in darker areas, mild softness, and faint exposure fluctuation.

The camera lingers as she continues eating casually, the pizza slice slowly disappearing bite by bite.

Overall feeling: intimate, playful, and candid — a messy late-night pizza moment captured with a handheld camcorder in a pre-digital bedroom setting.

一个年轻女子仰卧在床上，头微微倾向镜头。她穿着一件印有卡通披萨图案的俏皮衬衫。头发散落在枕头上。

镜头在她上方非常近的距离拍摄，使用广角消费级镜头，造成轻微的透视畸变。闪光灯使阴影变平，并在她的眼睛和披萨油渍上 tạo 出光泽高光。

她将一片意大利辣香肠披萨举到脸上方。

她慢慢地将其放到嘴边。

披萨片移动时，奶酪略微拉伸。闪光灯下，意大利辣香肠上的油光闪闪。披萨片在重力作用下自然弯曲，尖端向下垂。

她咬了一口。

饼皮在她的指间被压扁。她咬下去时，奶酪不均匀地拉扯和分离。一小缕融化的奶酪短暂地拉伸后断裂。

她咀嚼时，眼睛一直盯着镜头。

镜头保持非常近的距离，手持拍摄，轻微晃动，仿佛拍摄者正在调整握持姿势。闪光灯在披萨盒和光泽的配料上 tạo 出刺眼的反光。

图像质量显示出消费级模拟伪影：可见的颗粒感、较暗区域轻微的色彩噪点、轻微的柔和度以及微弱的曝光波动。

镜头在她继续随意进食时停留，披萨片一口一口地慢慢消失。

整体感觉：亲密、俏皮、真实——一个凌乱的深夜披萨时刻，在数码时代之前的卧室环境中，用手持摄像机捕捉。

path: prompts/真人/现实向/时尚写真/youmind-8979--Rainy-Bookstore-Lifestyle-Cinematic-Prom.md
prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic video using the reference image. Preserve the exact same woman, facial identity, hairstyle, outfit, bookstore interior, warm lighting, bookshelves, wooden furniture, and rainy weather outside. The video should feel like an authentic candid lifestyle moment, not a staged performance.

0–3 sec — Realizing the rain:
Wide shot from inside the bookstore looking toward the large rain-covered window. She walks toward the window holding her book, then stops when she notices the heavy rain outside. She looks through the glass at people walking past with umbrellas, her expression subtly changing to mild disappointment.

3–5 sec — Checking:
Medium side shot. She casually reaches into her bag, searches for a moment, then realizes she has no umbrella. She gives a tiny amused sigh and smiles at herself. Keep the expression subtle and natural.

5–8 sec — Giving up:
Close-up three-quarter shot. She looks back toward the cozy bookstore, glances at the rain again, then shrugs lightly as if deciding to wait it out. A loose strand of hair falls near her face and she casually tucks it behind her ear.

8–11 sec — Coffee instead:
Low tabletop angle. She walks to the nearby table, places her book beside the latte, sits down, and picks up the coffee. She takes a small sip while watching the rain through the window.

11–15 sec — Making the best of it:
Over-the-shoulder shot transitioning into a front three-quarter close-up. She opens her book and reads for a moment. She notices the camera, looks up, gives a small genuine smile and slightly raises her eyebrows as if saying “I guess I'm staying here.” She then turns back toward the book while rain continues outside.

Camera: Each shot should have a clearly different perspective — wide establishing shot, side profile, close-up, low tabletop angle, and over-the-shoulder/front portrait. Smooth natural cuts, subtle handheld camera movement, realistic autofocus and depth of field.

Realism: Photorealistic skin texture, natural blinking, subtle breathing, realistic hand and finger movements, physically accurate hair and clothing, believable walking and sitting motion, natural facial micro-expressions. Rain should behave realistically on the window. Warm indoor light should contrast naturally with the cool gray rainy exterior.

Overall aesthetic: Cozy Korean bookstore café, rainy afternoon, candid lifestyle vlog, understated K-drama atmosphere, natural cinematic photography, soft bokeh, realistic motion blur, 24fps, high detail.

Avoid: exaggerated acting, dramatic gestures, excessive camera movement, slow motion, sudden zooms, distorted hands, extra fingers, face morphing, identity changes, outfit changes, unrealistic walking, artificial smiles, or overly polished beauty-filter appearance.

- End with hands at a relaxed wide finger-frame pose.

地形逻辑
建筑语言

空间尺度

材质年代

植被生态
水系走向

云层结构
雾气规律
主光方向
整体色彩
反光表面
空气纵深

瀑布和水渠始终流动
山雾顺地势游走
植被服从统一风向
云层阴影在湿石上缓慢移动
倒影持续变化

远处建筑在雾中时隐时现
前中后景始终具备真实视差

同一个来自 @图片1 的 25–30 岁东亚剑仙女子。

瀑布灌入山间水渠

远处瓦顶建筑在雾中若隐若现
峡谷深处突然传来巨大而规律的“咚——咚——”声，像军阵战鼓。

prompt:
Seedance Video Prompt | 15 Seconds | Sword Training Correction
I. Generation Goal
Movie-grade realistic texture, pure ancient Chinese Xianxia aesthetics.
Overall features:
Elegant and clear martial arts choreography
Restrained relationship-based comedy
Arri Alexa film camera texture
Clear and stable facial details
Natural morning volumetric light
Fine film grain
Core Reversal Principle
The plot is entirely driven by the characters' own personalities, goals, and interactions. The environment is just an independent, real, and living world; it must not trigger the plot, solve problems, change character goals, or comment on the plot.
II. Environment Generation Principles
Before formal composition, all reference images jointly determine the environment's DNA.
Co-evolve compatible features: Terrain, Architecture, Spatial Scale, Age of materials, Vegetation, Water systems, Weather, Clouds, Fog density, Lighting direction, Reflection relationships, Color systems, Atmospheric depth.
Then reorganize this information into a unique, complete, and logical new space.
Environment Requirements
Background movement must be continuous, natural, and physically accurate. The environment must be 'alive' but remain neutral in narration. The environment must not steal the spotlight or actively create gags or drive character relationships.
III. Scene Setting
Location: A stone sword-training platform at a mountain gate reorganized from all reference images.
Environmental Anchors: Moist stone slabs after rain, carved stone railings, ancient pines, bamboo forest, distant tiled-roof halls, a continuous flowing narrow water channel, layered distant mountains, slowly moving valley fog. These elements establish a clear, stable, and real spatial relationship.
IV. Character Settings
Character ID A | Senior Sister Sword Immortal
Strictly maintain the same identity as @Image 1.
25–30 year old East Asian female, oval face, fair natural skin tone, dark almond eyes, long black hair half-tied with a white jade hairpin. Tall and slender, wearing white cloth boots, white embroidered silk Hanfu with semi-transparent layered wide sleeves, silver waist seal, and a jade pendant. Holds a unique silver longsword.
Character ID B | Junior Sister
Strictly maintain the same identity as @Image 2.
20–25 year old East Asian female, rounded and lively face, black hair in braids, petite build. Wearing blue-green linen Hanfu, dark belt, wooden hairpin, and black cloth shoes. Holds a unique dark steel sword.
V. Lens Structure
Shot 1 | 0–5s | Wide or Long Shot
Establish the entire sword-training platform space. Both characters enter the frame completely from feet to head, formally bow with swords, then raise swords simultaneously.
Dialogue
Junior sister says seriously: 'No letting me win today.'
Camera and Environment Requirements
The frame first clearly establishes the spatial relationship of the platform. The two characters are the main focus. The water channel flows continuously, valley fog moves slowly, pine branches and bamboo sway at different magnitudes in the wind. Reflections on the wet stone surface exist naturally. These changes are for spatial realism only and do not participate in the plot.
Shot 2 | 5–10s | Medium or Cowboy Shot
Enter the sparring process. Junior sister launches a serious and clean frontal thrust.
Action Design
Junior sister completes a clear frontal thrust. Senior sister takes only one side step and blocks once. After blocking, she naturally holds the junior's sword wrist and gently adjusts the angle downward. Senior sister says: 'Wrist is high again.' Junior sister immediately pulls away, attacks again, senior sister blocks again while gently tapping the junior's front foot with her white boot to narrow her stance. Senior sister adds: 'Feet too wide.'
Environment Requirements
The same training platform remains stable. The water channel, fog, and vegetation continue their natural movements. Reflections change naturally with the camera angle. Background changes must remain neutral.
Shot 3 | 10–15s | Close-up or Extreme Close-up
Junior sister suddenly stops, her sword still in an offensive posture. She finally can't help asking.
Dialogue and Action
Junior sister asks: 'Sister, are you here for a duel or to teach me?'
Senior sister remains expressionless, only uses two fingers to gently push the junior's slightly tilted sword tip straight. Senior sister answers calmly: 'Win over your bad habits first.'
Complete pause for half a beat. Then: Junior sister glares at her but doesn't argue, instead silently adjusts her wrist angle and foot position as instructed. Then she strikes again.
Ending
Extreme close-up captures a very slight, almost imperceptible satisfied smile at the corner of the senior sister's mouth. The two longswords touch precisely off-screen with a single crisp metallic 'Clang' to end.
VI. Technical Requirements
Strict total duration: 15 seconds. 16:9 horizontal screen. Three continuous clear shots. Native synchronized Mandarin dialogue. No subtitles generated.
VII. Stability Requirements
Must strictly ensure: facial stability, clothing stability, sword stability, clear geographic relationships, clear spatial axes, logical actions, real body mechanics, and clean, restrained, readable martial arts movements.
VIII. Physical and Environmental Requirements
Elements like body movements, silk fabric, hair, water flow, mountain fog, vegetation, reflections, and spatial ambient sound must be real and natural. Only the two visible characters should appear.
IX. Negative

prompt:
[Generation Mode and Total Requirements]

Must use Seedance 2.0 Fast, strictly generate a full 15-second video, 16:9 widescreen, three continuous clear shots, with native synchronized Mandarin dialogue.

Master-level cinematic realistic texture, Arri Alexa film camera look, with a restrained and poetic Xianxia deadpan comedy temperament. The image is sharp and clear, volumetric morning light is naturally visible, acting is restrained, character movement is realistic but cinematic, and silk fabric, hair, paper, water flow, mountain mist, and natural light have believable physical feedback.

Adopting the 'Reference Image-Driven Living World System': All reference images together determine the location and visual world, including topographic logic, architectural language, spatial scale, material age, vegetation ecology, water flow direction, weather state, cloud movement, main light direction, reflective surfaces, comprehensive colors, and atmospheric depth. Before official generation, complete a round of environmental planning silently, reorganizing a new, unified, physically reasonable space from these common environmental DNAs.

The background must be vivid, unique, and continue to operate naturally, but only responsible for environmental presence, not actively triggering punchlines, changing character goals, or stealing the center of the plot.

[Characters and Core Props]

Character ID A | Swordmaster Senior Sister
Always the same 25-30 year old East Asian female from @Image 1, strictly maintaining the same face, oval face shape, fair natural skin tone, dark almond eyes, black long hair half-tied, white jade hairpin, tall and slender body proportions, white embroidered silk Hanfu, semi-transparent layered wide sleeves, silver waist seal, jade pendant, and white cloth boots.
Character ID B | Junior Sister
Always the same 20-25 year old East Asian female from @Image 2, strictly maintaining the same face, rounded and lively face shape, black hair braided, petite body proportions, green linen Hanfu, dark waist belt, wooden hairpin, and black cloth shoes.

Core Prop
Only one and the same sealed bamboo scroll throughout. The position, opening state, and holding relationship of the bamboo scroll in the three shots must be continuous and stable.

[0–5s | Low-angle panorama, slow track]

The mountain gate corridor stone platform on a morning after rain. Below is a sea of clouds and a valley, carved stone railings, wet slate, narrow canals, ancient pines, light-colored flowering branches, distant tiled palaces, slowly wandering mountain mist, and continuously changing wetland reflections together establish a real, breathing environment.
The same white-clad swordmaster senior sister and the same green-clad junior sister are located on both sides of the stone table.

The white-clad senior sister gently puts the same sealed bamboo scroll on the stone table between them, saying calmly:

'Three years ago, you left something behind. Today it is returned.'

The environment maintains restrained motion: the canal flows continuously, the mist slowly passes through the corridor, branches and hems respond to the same morning breeze, and the reflection on the stone surface after the rain changes naturally with the camera track.

[5–10s | Cowboy shot within a shot]

The same green-clad junior sister slowly reaches out to take the same bamboo scroll, while her other hand naturally rests by her sword.

The same white-clad senior sister maintains a completely calm expression and adds a sentence:

'I have already graded it for you.'

Nearby leaves naturally drift past the screen, forming realistic foreground parallax; the canal continues to flow, and mountain mist slowly wanders between the corridors.

The background always maintains only a sense of world presence and does not actively create new plot events.

The junior sister starts to unfold the bamboo scroll after taking it, maintaining continuous action for the next shot.

[10–15s | Close-up to extreme close-up]

The same bamboo scroll is fully unfolded.

Inside is not a secret manual, but an old love poem written by the same green-clad junior sister three years ago; the paper is densely written with neat, elegant red annotations.

The same green-clad junior sister freezes instantly and asks in a low voice:

'You read it all?'

The same white-clad senior sister answers calmly:

'I also changed three rhyme schemes; the third line is the best.'

An extreme close-up captures the junior sister's ears turning noticeably red.

The senior sister remains dignified, calm, and without any hint of mockery.

At this moment, a drop of rain from the eaves naturally falls into the same canal, making a slight and clear water sound, as the final deadpan beat.

Strictly ends at 15.0 seconds.

[Execution Hard Constraints]

Must use Seedance 2.0 Fast
Must generate full 15 seconds, no shortening to 10 seconds, no early ending
16:9 widescreen
Strictly three shots
Native synchronized Mandarin dialogue
Accurate Mandarin lip-syncing
Character identity, face, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing stable throughout
The same bamboo scroll is continuous and stable, no duplication, no disappearing, no replacement
Foreground, midground, and background have realistic parallax
Environment continues to live, but must not steal the scene
Silk, paper, water flow, mountain mist, hair, flower branches, raindrops, and light are physically real
Only two visible characters appear at all times
No screen subtitles generated
No extra characters appear

[Negative]
blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, subtitles, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, hairstyle change, background shift, architecture mutation, lighting jump, glitching cuts, disappearing props, duplicated bamboo scroll, changing scroll design, extra characters, background crowd, environment stealing focus, random environmental gag, exaggerated comedy acting, slapstick reaction, overacting, modern elements, frozen background, static fog, static water, no parallax, abrupt camera jump, dialogue desync, lip-sync error

path: prompts/真人/特效向/奇幻怪兽/youmind-8991--Colossal-Dragon-Disaster-Scene-Prompt.md
prompt:
[Specifications] Hyper-realistic live-action, IMAX-level Hollywood giant beast disaster film, ARRI Alexa 35 texture. Bright Jakarta daytime, blue sky and strong sunlight, even if smoke and fire are pervasive, it cannot turn into night. The entire video is pure chaos, with no calm passages, static displays, slow motion, or BGM, only real disaster SFX.

[Continuity] Uploaded image as the strictly consistent first frame. Throughout the video, there is only the same ultra-giant flying dragon, strictly maintaining its face, horns, black-gray scales, red wing membranes, wing structure, proportions, and scale; no deformation, shrinking, or extra limbs allowed. The location is always Jakarta Bundaran HI–Sudirman, retaining the Selamat Datang Monument, fountains, real roads, and skyline.

[Core Rules] Rapid alternation between giant dragon destruction, office documentary POV, street escape POV, and dynamic aerial photography, using hard cuts or action matching, morphing is prohibited. Destruction must accumulate and be permanently retained: shattered glass, burning floors, missing outer walls, exposed steel beams, and broken floor slabs remain consistent in all subsequent angles, and buildings are prohibited from returning to integrity after a camera cut. Each destruction follows the sequence of contact → deformation → fracture → falling → smoke/dust.

[0–3 Seconds] The first frame erupts immediately. 24mm street ultra-wide angle high-speed push-in; the dragon's chest expands, the throat glows orange-white, continuously breathing real fire with a white-hot core, orange-red outer flame, black smoke, and heatwave refraction at two high-rise buildings. Glass explodes along the trajectory, multiple indoor floors catch fire, and people and vehicles scatter immediately.

[3–6 Seconds] Hard cut to worm-eye high-speed tracking, camera moving through vehicles and crowds. Burning outer walls fall to the ground first, then detonate empty cars; the shockwave pushes the camera askew. The giant dragon stomps once, the road surface cracks, the fountain tilts, car suspensions bounce, and foreground debris results in a near-miss.

[6–9 Seconds] 45-degree bird’s-eye descending orbit of about 120°, showing at least 3 high-rise buildings continuously burning. The giant dragon sweeps the upper structures while turning, then the left wing strikes a glass office building; action matching cuts indoors just as the wingtip is about to make contact.

[9–14 Seconds] Office over-the-shoulder documentary handheld. The camera is fixed 3-4 meters behind office workers; everyone has their back to the camera, facing the floor-to-ceiling windows and the dragon, only backs, backs of heads, and raised phones are seen, phone cameras facing out the window, screens showing the dragon. Absolutely no personnel allowed to face the main camera. Someone notices the giant wing approaching first, puts down their phone, and pulls a colleague away. Wing bones bend the glass and metal frames, cracks spread, then the entire curtain wall explodes; the giant wing penetrates several meters, continuously destroying the upper and lower 6-8 layers of outer walls, desks, chairs, partitions, and ceilings, floor slabs crack, and steel beams are exposed. The crowd falls to protect their heads and drags each other away, the photographer falls, and glass scrapes past the lens.

[14–17 Seconds] The giant wing withdraws, creating negative pressure, papers are sucked outdoors, and sprinklers activate. Hard cut to an external high-speed 180° orbital, clearly showing a massive 6-8 story building wound; the giant wing continues to slice through the curtain wall, furniture and concrete fall according to gravity, and the distant fire persists.

[17–21 Seconds] Street office workers running POV, employees, security guards, and the injured helping each other. Backwards whip-pan: the damaged building continues to collapse, the dragon's tail strikes the corner of another high-rise, and more than ten stories of outer wall progressively fall; the crowd hears the impact first then reacts realistically according to the direction of falling objects.

[21–25 Seconds] True 90° top-down helicopter shot descending and rotating at high speed, clearly seeing the fountain, giant dragon, cracked road, burning vehicles, and scattering people; at least 5 buildings are burning, missing outer walls, or partially collapsed. The dragon breathes fire in an arc along the evacuated lane, objects burn only after contact.

[25–28 Seconds] Camera lowers to a high-speed bird’s-eye banking wide. The giant dragon's wing sweeps away large areas of the curtain wall of already damaged towers, and a chain collapse occurs from top to bottom; the camera near-misses through falling glass and steel structures, no clipping.

[28–30 Seconds] Ultra-wide helicopter shot high-speed banking, pulling back and rising. The giant dragon spreads its wings at Bundaran HI, breathing a massive fire column toward distant ruins; multiple damaged skyscrapers, burning floors, exposed steel beams, black smoke columns, police lights, and escaping crowds are all visible, the skyline must not be tidy. Ends in continuous destruction, no posing, no fading out.

[Performance & Physics] The crowd has Hollywood A-grade disaster film performance: identify danger first then react, eyes, breathing, center of gravity, falling, and rescue conform to real human mechanics; no one looks at the camera. Camera dynamics are intense but professional, subject always readable. Prohibited: random explosions, floating cars, rubber buildings, clipping, repetitive movements, size changes, game CGI, glitches, text, watermarks. Sound only: dragon roar, fire breathing, wing vibration, glass explosion, steel beam twisting, collapse, alarms, sirens, footsteps, and real shouting.

1. Segment Definition

Cinematic realistic texture. Utilizing a 'reference-image-driven living world system,' blending poetic Xianxia tension, space-misleading comedy, restrained performance, chilly silver-blue morning, warm sunrise reflections, natural volumetric mountain mist, and realistic wet stone and water physical effects. The final reversal must be achieved entirely through visibility changes. Geographic structure must be continuous; no sudden scene changes or terrain deformations allowed.

2. Reference Responsibilities
Seedance 2.0 supports image, audio, and video references; thus, all reference images are treated as a single world setting library, not isolated backgrounds. Reference images collectively determine:
Continuous terrain, architectural logic, spatial scale, material era, vegetation ecology, water levels and systems, weather status, cloud movement, mist density, main light direction, reflection relationships, sound distance perception, and realistic character movement paths.

Pre-generation Internal Environment Deduction:
Execute a silent environmental deduction first. Reorganize a unique new space based on all reference images. This space must be physically unified, structurally continuous, realistically schedulable by the camera, have stable foreground/midground/background anchors, and maintain the environment DNA of the same world.

3. Character Lock
Character ID A | White-clad Sword Immortal: Same 25–30 year old East Asian female sword immortal. Strictly maintain: @Image 1 (same face), black long hair, slender body proportions, white embroidered silk Hanfu, jade accessories, white cloth boots, and a unique long silver sword.
Character ID B | Green-clad Rival: Same 20–25 year old East Asian female rival. Strictly maintain: @Image 2 (same face), black braided hair, petite body proportions, green Hanfu, dark cloth boots, and a unique dark steel sword.

4. Storyboard Design
Shot 1 | 0–5s | Wide or Extreme Wide Shot
Goal: Establish a misleading spatial relationship, making the audience and characters believe there is a bottomless canyon ahead.
Content: Two characters stand fully from head to toe on two ancient stone platforms covered in wet moss. Heavy mist blocks the view between them, making it look like a bottomless chasm.
Anchors: Waterfall disappears into the mist; pine branches sway naturally at different depths; water droplets flow slowly on stone; distant tiled buildings appear and disappear in the mist; rising sun pushes the mist horizontally.
Performance: Both remain cautious and restrained, as if facing a great enemy. Establish the spatial misdirection first.

Shot 2 | 5–10s | Medium or Cowboy Shot
Goal: Both misjudge the spatial scale and prepare high-consumption sword-crossing moves.
Continuity: Maintain same characters, outfits, swords, geography, mist/platform logic, and environment anchors (pines, waterfall, tiled buildings).
Action: Both enter a charging state. Wide sleeves are lifted by airflow; sword blades emit low-frequency resonance; mist swirls around ankles. Dignified, formal, and restrained posture.
Dialogue: White-clad immortal says calmly: 'This sword strike crosses the canyon.' Green-clad woman replies: 'I'll be waiting.'
Camera: Slow orbital shot around the duo. Anchors must remain visible to verify space.

Shot 3 | 10–15s | Close-up or Extreme Close-up
Goal: Complete the reversal through visibility changes. The truth must come from clearing the existing environment, not generating a new one.
Event: A natural mountain wind clears the last layer of mist. Reveal: The 'bottomless canyon' is actually just a three-step-wide ancient mountain irrigation canal. Dark water and vertical stone reflections caused the depth illusion.
Hard Constraints: Continuity of stone edges, waterfall entry, moss, pines, tiled buildings, sun direction, and mist logic. Nothing should morph suddenly.
Performance: Both freeze with swords raised. Green-clad woman looks down slowly and says: 'Maybe... just walk over?' White-clad immortal silently sheathes her sword, steps across on three existing rocks, and says impassively as she passes: 'Saves spiritual power.'
Ending: Extreme close-up of the green-clad woman trying to suppress a smile. The formerly grand 'canyon waterfall sound' now sounds like a small bubbling canal.

5. Audio-Visual & Physical Requirements
Native synchronous Mandarin dialogue; consistent spatial sound; unified physical logic for wind, mist, water, and reflections; continuous natural motion and parallax; realistic movement for silk, hair, and droplets.

6. Technical Specifications
Strict duration: 15 seconds; 16:9 aspect ratio; 3 continuous clear shots; only 2 visible characters; no subtitles.

7. Negative
blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

Consistent facial features, hairstyle, clothing, hair accessories, and accessories. This segment occurs during daylight, set before the "Goodnight Cloud City" night finale. Positioning: 15-second continuous single shot, realistic, serendipitous MiniDV selfie video. The protagonist always holds the silver-grey MiniDV with her right hand, wrist strap securely around the right wrist. No photographer, no third-person shots, no drones, no external wide-angle positions. Selfie distance approx 45cm. She first ascends the grassy slope in the selfie video, naturally stops upon seeing the Celestial Gate, then rotates the camera from herself to the landscape via body and right wrist movement, and finally turns back to a semi-selfie composition. 16:9 MiniDV widescreen mode, preserving walking undulations, wind-induced jitter, imperfect composition, brief focus loss, exposure breathing, auto-white balance hesitation, motion blur, slight interlacing streaks, fine DV grain, and highlight clipping. The focus is to record the sense of scale of the Celestial Gate existing above the city, not a smooth fantasy architectural promotional film. Scene Lock: Protagonist stands on a slowly rising grassy slope on the outskirts of Cloud City. Grassy surface has realistic blades of varying lengths, some bare soil, and small puddles. As high-altitude wind blows, blades flatten sequentially from near to far, not all at once. Below the slope is a massive ancient Chinese city with dense black-tile roofs and reddish-brown buildings; several rivers pass through with water reflecting the sky; small bridges, piers, and streets remain fixed; city residents are only tiny, slow activities in the distance; the city must not float, fold, or change layout during camera rotation. The giant suspended Celestial Gate is far above the city, covering most of the sky. Turquoise double-eaves, dark wood structures, red pillars, and a massive central portal maintain reference image proportions. Clouds continuously pass slowly beneath the gate, between pillars, and around eaves, but without obscuring the entire structure. The gate itself is extremely heavy and stable, with no bobbing or rotation. A dark moon hangs in the distance within the central portal, with a thin cold-white light arc at its edge. It is a distant celestial body, not a portal, doesn't emit beams, and doesn't move fast. The dark moon stays near the central portal, with slight framing shifts only due to the protagonist's wrist angle. Sunbeams from the right form two or three stable diagonal light columns through cloud gaps. Birds fly in scattered small groups across eaves and clouds, not surrounding the protagonist or diving at the camera. Strict Time Breakdown: 0—4s: Cresting the slope to see the gate. Recording starts with the protagonist finishing the last steps of the slope. MiniDV at arm-length selfie view. About two-thirds of her face is in frame, forehead slightly cropped; only wind-blown grass, sky, and few clouds visible behind. Walking steps create realistic vertical camera shake. She pants slightly, left hand naturally tidying clothes touched by grass. Reaching the top, she slows down, looking past the camera. Her eyes widen slightly, but no exaggerated scream. After a short pause: "I just crested this slope... and I saw it." She remains looking ahead, not immediately refocusing on the camera. 4—9s: Full gate appearance. She stands firm, then slowly pans forward via waist and right wrist rotation. The camera passes her cheek, hair accessories, shoulder fabric, and slope edge, gradually revealing the city below and the gate in the sky. Auto-focus lingers on near grass before finding the distant architecture. A visible exposure breath occurs as bright sky enters; the gate whitens briefly before details return to eaves, pillars, clouds, and city. Off-camera, she laughs incredulously: "I didn't zoom in... it's really this big." Her mouth is away from the mic, voice muffled by wind noise. 9—12s: Dark moon aligned in portal. Maintains orientation, no auto-zoom or digital zoom. Right hand makes one small upward adjustment to center the portal and moon. Due to wind, composition has fine drift, not tripod-stable. Clouds pass behind pillars; birds fly from top-left to right; sunbeams light parts of the eaves. Moon remains stable, light arc clear but not blinding. She whispers off-camera: "Look at the center... that moon is perfectly in the gate." Auto-focus hesitates between birds and gate but doesn't lose the subject. 12—15s: Lingering at the top. Slowly turns the MiniDV halfway back to herself. Final imperfect semi-selfie framing: half her face on one side, gate, clouds, and moon still occupying most of the frame. Strong wind blows hair strands; she squints naturally, looks back at the gate once, breathing slows. No posing, just a light smile: "I want to stay here... for a while." Recording doesn't stop; she doesn't explain further. Camera pans slightly back to the landscape; final second keeps wind-blown grass, moving clouds, distant gate, and sparse bird calls; recording ends naturally. Environment Dynamic Lock: Gate remains suspended, no descent/rotation/movement towards protagonist. Clouds only move slowly through pillars/eaves. Moon is fixed, no enlargement/emission. Bird flight directions unified, wing rhythms slightly varied. Birds have scale change but no teleporting/cloning. Light beams stable. Grass ripples in gusts by zone. River flows slowly. Performance & Sound: Emotion path: fatigue -> discovery -> scale realization -> moon observation -> quiet presence. Rely on natural breathing, pauses, eye movement, squinting, and restrained smiles. No screaming/gaping/broad gestures. Mic captures: constant slope wind, grass friction, footsteps on soil, fabric rustle, bird calls, faint city bells/voices, close-range wind-muffled speech. No BGM, no AI narration. Negative Constraints: No photographer, no third-person back-views, no reference woman, no drones, no aerials, no external panoramas, no rotations around protagonist. No gate falling, no buildings flying or deforming. No moon turning into black hole, no explosions, no lightning, no doomsday. No bird attacks, no cloning, no static birds. No face swapping, no clothing redraws. No auto-zoom, no cinema black bars, no subtitles, no logos.
